content.text: In Nigeria, where Gumroad is blocked by the government, digital creators can't collect payment for ebooks, courses, and design assets. This is not just a Nigerian problem - it's a global issue. Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad charge high fees and restrict access in many countries. To overcome this [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide-3|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-2|The Full]] problem, COREMERCH offers a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows creators to sell design assets with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-costing-you|crypto]] payments, without relying on these platforms. This stack uses NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification, Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Supabase for order storage - all with a transparent 0.5% fee.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

A sovereign digital commerce stack is not just a workaround for payment restrictions - it's a base-layer infrastructure solution that gives creators full ownership and control over their online store. With this stack, creators can deploy their own infrastructure, load their products, and configure automatic crypto payment processing without relying on any external platform. This means they can sell ebooks, courses, and design assets without paying high fees or facing access restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack uses a combination of free and paid tools to provide a fully operational online store. This includes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain payment verification with a transparent 0.5% fee. This architecture ensures that creators have full control over their online store and can configure automatic crypto payment processing without relying on any external platform.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack is designed for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. This includes creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and other regions. With this stack, creators can sell ebooks, courses, and design assets without paying high fees or facing access restrictions.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack consists of several key components. These include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain payment verification with a transparent 0.5% fee. Each component is carefully selected to provide a seamless and secure payment experience for creators and their customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. This kit provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Once the kit is purchased, creators can follow a simple checklist to deploy their stack, including configuring automatic crypto payment processing with NOWPayments, loading their products, and configuring order storage with Supabase.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
